title: Timed Inhibit on ROM Bin Sprayer (Rock Breaker)

fields.equipment: ROM bin sprays, rock breaker position sensor
fields.latestPosition: Timed inhibit to stop the ROM bin sprayer running continuously while the rock breaker is in position. DocuSign completed 16/09/2026 – all parties signed.
fields.nextAction: PCS to implement now fully signed.
fields.why: The ROM bin sprays run continuously while the rock breaker is in sensor range unless put in manual off. This sends excess water into the process, and sprays left in manual off affect dust suppression.
fields.design:
- Add a timer/inhibit: when the sensor triggers, sprays run for a set period, then stay off until the sensor clears and re-triggers
- Keep existing functionality for the loader
fields.impact: Sprays can be left in Auto; they run one cycle while the rock breaker is in position, removing the need to switch to manual off.
